_meanings:
.²1 An impediment, obstacle, hindrance, what stands in the
 way; {#sa cet tvamantarAyo Bavasi cyuto viDiH#} <ls>R. 3. 45</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 65</ls>; {#vahvantarAyayuktasya#}
 {#Darmasya tvaritA gatiH#} <ls>Pt. 3. 101</ls>; {#asya te bARapaTavartinaH kfzRasArasya#}
 {#antarAyO tapAsvinO saMvfttO#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>.
 <ab>v. l.</ab> standing in the way.
.²2 (In Vedānta) Hindrance to the concentration of mind which is said
 to be of four kinds, {#laya, vikzepa, kazAya#} and {#rasAsvAda#}.
.²3 An intervention, a covering, screen; {#dAhapremhRA sarasabisinIpatramAtrAntarAyaH#} <ls>Māl. 3. 12</ls>.
.²4 (With the Jainas) Interference or obstruction offered to those who
 are engaged in seeking deliverance, and consequent prevention of their
 accomplishment of it; one of the 8 classes of {%karman%}.
